open.title: Open
open.truncated: Only the first 500 files are listed
open.attachHelp: Pick a NIfTI segmentation (.nii or .nii.gz) from any shared folder, e.g. the seg/ or labelsTr/ folder next to the images. It must have the same shape and orientation as the image; it is never resampled.
open.axisHelp: A NumPy array has no geometry. Pick the order in which the middle slice looks right.

axis.xyz: nibabel: arr[i, j, k], i → x

open.axisNeeded: The axis order of this array is unknown (no sidecar, no reference image).
open.dialogHelp: Pick a folder, or a NIfTI, NumPy or DICOM file. Nothing is written to any project.
open.saveHelp: A new .nii.gz is written once into this folder, never over an existing file (a -1, -2 … suffix is added). Your source files are never touched.
open.sidecar: Also write the DICOM tags (JSON sidecar)
open.anonymize: Anonymize (PS3.15 Basic Profile subset): neutral file name, patient name and ID
open.phiNotice: DICOM tags can contain patient data (names, IDs, dates, institutions). Keep sidecars in the derived folder; anonymize before sharing.
open.addHelp: The file becomes a new import of the chosen project, next to its other sources. DICOM goes through the converter.
open.noSessionHelp: Open a file or folder to view it without a project. The address bar names the session, never the path.

tasks.listHelp: Item ids, separated by spaces, commas or new lines
tasks.sourceHelp: Choose the DICOM folder (or one DICOM file) to convert. It is read only; outputs go to the project's derived folder.
tasks.derivedNeeded: This task writes volumes: the project needs a derived folder first.
tasks.waitingHelp: Waiting for the host runner: start scripts/rw-runner.py in the plugin's environment (TASKS.md §External runtime).
tasks.noRunner: No runner is online for this task. Start scripts/rw-runner.py on the host ({{hint}}).

err.pattern: Does not match the expected pattern

tasks.derivedHelp: Task outputs (NIfTI volumes, masks, DICOM sidecars) are written here, never next to your data. Only output folders shared with the app are listed.
tasks.radiomicsHere: Radiomics runs are set up in the Radiomics settings tab (the same tab as Tasks › Radiomics and the Radiomics view).

psettings.title: Project settings
psettings.conflict: The project settings were changed by someone else. Reload them and apply your changes again, or discard your changes.
psettings.fullLinkHelp: Anyone with this link can view and edit the project (there are no accounts).
psettings.viewLinkHelp: Opens the project read-only: no editing controls, and the server refuses every write. Rotating it stops the old link at once.
psettings.ctWindowHelp: HU; other modalities open on the 1st–99th percentile window.
psettings.dicomWindow: Use the DICOM WindowCenter/Width first when the series has one
psettings.presetsHelp: Empty = the built-in presets (Soft tissue, Bone, Lung, Brain, Kidney).
psettings.noLabels: No labels yet: they are named from mask values at import, or come from a study pack.
psettings.importHelp: 3D Slicer colour table (.ctbl), ITK-SNAP label description or nnU-Net dataset.json; labels with the same value are replaced, others kept.
psettings.importFailed: {{name}} is not a label file this app can read
psettings.packsHelp: A pack sets labels, the phase vocabulary and the organ focus of the analyzers. Applying one never deletes curation, labels or data.
psettings.layersHelp: Plugin data joined onto the imported rows (analyzers, curation, labeling); metadata.jsonl itself is never rewritten. The dataset table merges both, one column per layer.
psettings.exportJsonlHelp: One JSON line per item: the imported metadata, every active layer and references to DICOM sidecars and analyzer records
psettings.exportSensitive: Include sensitive fields (patient id, dates, UIDs, accession numbers)

conv.anonymize: Anonymize (PS3.15 Basic Profile subset: sidecars and rows)
conv.phiNotice: DICOM headers can contain patient data. Sidecars stay in the derived folder; anonymize before sharing.
conv.needsDerived: This project has no derived folder for the converted volumes yet.
conv.datasetHelp: metadata.jsonl, NIfTI volumes, DICOM sidecars and the analyzer layers. Open it, make a project from it, or add it to an existing project.
conv.projectDone: The converted series were imported into the project.
conv.nameTaken: A dataset named {{name}} exists; this one will be saved as {{next}}.

design.subtitle: Tokens, type and icons of the P0.5 design system. Theme: {{theme}}.

import.aliasHelp: Items store paths as {{alias}}:relative/path, so the project survives a move.
import.aliasInvalid: Use 1–16 characters: a letter first, then letters, digits or _.
import.aliasTaken: {{alias}} is already this project's alias for {{path}}. Pick another name.
import.reconstruct: Reconstruct DICOM tags for rows without a sidecar
import.reconstructHelp: Builds a partial tag list from the DICOM fields each row already has (kVp, window, UIDs…), marked as reconstructed. Written to the project's derived folder only; a real sidecar always wins.
import.suggestHelp: Built from the file names in this folder. Picking one fills the pattern field; review and edit it before Preview.
import.suggestNone: No NIfTI or NumPy files directly in this folder to suggest from.
import.suggestNoMatch: No common structure found in these file names; the default (one case per file) applies.
import.errorsHelp: Rows with errors are indexed with a QC warning; they appear in the Problems panel.
import.indexingHelp: Thumbnails are generated in the background after indexing.
import.readOnly: The data root is read-only for this app. Inputs are snapshotted into the project; images and masks are never written.
import.rootHelp: Choose a folder (with metadata.jsonl, NIfTI or DICOM files) or one NIfTI file. The folder becomes a path alias of this project.
import.skipHelp: The project is created either way — import data later from File → Import data.
import.scanning: Looking for metadata.jsonl, NIfTI, DICOM and NumPy files…
import.uploadAlt: No server access to the files? You can upload the metadata files from the browser instead (images stay on the server).
import.uploadToggle: Upload the metadata files from this computer
import.noMetadata: No metadata.jsonl under this root. Pick another folder or upload the file.

nifti.unmatched_other: {{count}} names did not match the pattern: {{names}}
nifti.withMask: With the segmentation attached in Open mode: {{mask}}
nifti.patternPrefilled: Filled from the file names (the converter's naming: scan, case, channel). Edit it, or clear it for one case per file.

adapterHint.open: Open mode: view without a project

lbl.derivedUsers_other: The derived variables {{list}} use it and will show as broken until you delete them in Variables.
lbl.inspectorNoCase: Open a case to fill its label tables.
lbl.inspectorNoTables: No label tables yet. Create one in the Labeling view.
lbl.notARow: Not a row of this table (excluded upstream).
lbl.empty: No label tables yet. A table has rows per patient, CT scan or item and typed columns; every column becomes a study variable.

levelHelp.item: one row per viewable item (scan × scope × side)

lbl.refHistory: Mirrors {{name}}: its values come from there, so this column has no history of its own.
lbl.fillHelp: Empty clears the cells. Values are checked against each column's type.
lbl.importReport: {{matched}} of {{n}} rows matched by {{key}}; {{events}} cells written.
lbl.renameHelp: Renaming keeps the variable names (lbl.…) used in filters and analyses.
lbl.deleteTableHelp: The table leaves the Labeling view and its columns stop being study variables. Its values and cell history are kept, and you can restore it from Deleted tables.
lbl.colTypeFixed: Type: {{type}} (fixed; add a new column for another type)
lbl.levelsKeep: Removing a level keeps the values already entered.
lbl.deleteColumnHelp: The column is hidden and stops being a study variable. Its values and cell history are kept; restore it from Edit table.
lbl.tableGone: This table was deleted. Restore it from Deleted tables in the Labeling view.
